reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5300, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَنُو النَّجَّارِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ، ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ بَنُو سَاعِدَةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ، فَقَبَضَ أَصَابِعَهُ، ثُمَّ بَسَطَهُنَّ كَالرَّامِي بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah narrated to us: Al-Layth narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id al-Ansari, who heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘Shall I tell you which clans of the Ansar are best?’ They said, ‘Yes, Messenger of Allah.’ He said, ‘Banu al-Najjar, then those closest to them, Banu ‘Abd al-Ashhal; then those closest to them, Banu al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj; then those closest to them, Banu Sa‘idah.’ He gestured with his hand, closing his fingers and then spreading them as though throwing something, and said, ‘There is good in every clan of the Ansar.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5301, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةَ كَهَذِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ أَوْ كَهَاتَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَرَنَ بَيْنَ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى‏.‏
en_text: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: Abu Hazim said: I heard Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi, a Companion of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say that the Messenger of Allah said, ‘My being sent and the Hour are like this and this’—or ‘like these two.’ He joined his index and middle fingers.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5302, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ، سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الشَّهْرُ هَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي ثَلاَثِينَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا وَهَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ يَعْنِي تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ يَقُولُ، مَرَّةً ثَلاَثِينَ وَمَرَّةً تِسْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ‏.‏
en_text: Adam narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us: Jabal ibn Suhaym narrated to us: I heard Ibn ‘Umar say that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘The month is like this, and this, and this’—meaning 30 days. Then he said, ‘And like this, and this, and this’—meaning 29 days. At times he counted 30 and at times 29.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5303, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ وَأَشَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْيَمَنِ ‏"‏ الإِيمَانُ هَا هُنَا ـ مَرَّتَيْنِ ـ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ الْقَسْوَةَ وَغِلَظَ الْقُلُوبِ فِي الْفَدَّادِينَ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ رَبِيعَةَ وَمُضَرَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Yahya ibn Sa‘id narrated to us, from Isma‘il, from Qays, from Abu Mas‘ud, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, pointed with his hand toward Yemen and said, ‘Faith is over here’—twice. ‘Indeed, harshness and hard-heartedness are among the loud camel herders, where the two horns of Satan rise: Rabi‘ah and Mudar.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5304, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ هَكَذَا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى، وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا‏.‏
en_text: ‘Amr ibn Zurarah narrated to us: ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Abi Hazim informed us, from his father, from Sahl, who said: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘I and the one who cares for an orphan will be in Paradise like this.’ He pointed with his index and middle fingers and held them slightly apart.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5305, book 68, باب إِذَا عَرَّضَ بِنَفْىِ الْوَلَدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ أَسْوَدُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ لَكَ مِنْ إِبِلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَلْوَانُهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ حُمْرٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ فِيهَا مِنْ أَوْرَقَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَنَّى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ لَعَلَّهُ نَزَعَهُ عِرْقٌ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّ ابْنَكَ هَذَا نَزَعَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Qaza‘ah narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayrah, that a man came to the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and said, ‘Messenger of Allah, a black boy has been born to me.’ He asked, ‘Do you have camels?’ The man said, ‘Yes.’ He asked, ‘What colors are they?’ He replied, ‘Red.’ He asked, ‘Is there a gray one among them?’ He said, ‘Yes.’ He asked, ‘How did that happen?’ He said, ‘Perhaps it inherited a strain.’ He said, ‘Perhaps this son of yours inherited a strain.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5306, book 68, باب إِحْلاَفِ الْمُلاَعِنِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَأَحْلَفَهُمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
en_text: Musa ibn Isma‘il narrated to us: Juwayriyah narrated to us, from Nafi‘, from ‘Abd Allah, may Allah be pleased with him, that a man from the Ansar accused his wife of adultery. The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, had them both swear the prescribed oaths, then separated them.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5307, book 68, باب يَبْدَأُ الرَّجُلُ بِالتَّلاَعُنِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ هِلاَلَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ، قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ، فَجَاءَ فَشَهِدَ وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَامَتْ فَشَهِدَتْ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to me: Ibn Abi ‘Adi narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Hassan: ‘Ikrimah narrated to us, from Ibn ‘Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, that Hilal ibn Umayyah accused his wife of adultery. He came and testified while the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, was saying, ‘Allah knows that one of you is lying. Will either of you repent?’ Then she stood and testified.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5308, book 68, باب اللِّعَانِ وَمَنْ طَلَّقَ بَعْدَ اللِّعَانِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلاَنِيَّ جَاءَ إِلَى عَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ الأَنْصَارِيِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا عَاصِمُ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ، أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ سَلْ لِي يَا عَاصِمُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ عَاصِمٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَكَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسَائِلَ وَعَابَهَا، حَتَّى كَبُرَ عَلَى عَاصِمٍ مَا سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ عَاصِمٌ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ جَاءَهُ عُوَيْمِرٌ فَقَالَ يَا عَاصِمُ مَاذَا قَالَ لَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ لِعُوَيْمِرٍ لَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِخَيْرٍ، قَدْ كَرِهَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَسْأَلَةَ الَّتِي سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَنْتَهِي حَتَّى أَسْأَلَهُ عَنْهَا‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عُوَيْمِرٌ حَتَّى جَاءَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَطَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَتَقْتُلُونَهُ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ أُنْزِلَ فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَتَلاَعَنَا وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ تَلاَعُنِهِمَا قَالَ عُوَيْمِرٌ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا‏.‏ فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَتْ سُنَّةَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ‏.‏
en_text: Isma‘il narrated to us, saying: Malik narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, that Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi informed him that ‘Uwaymir al-‘Ajlani came to ‘Asim ibn ‘Adi al-Ansari and said, ‘‘Asim, what do you think if a man finds another man with his wife? Should he kill him, in which case you would kill him, or what should he do? Ask the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, about it for me.’ ‘Asim asked the Messenger of Allah about it, but the Messenger of Allah disliked questions of that sort and criticized them, until what ‘Asim heard from him weighed heavily on him. When ‘Asim returned to his family, ‘Uwaymir came and said, ‘‘Asim, what did the Messenger of Allah say to you?’ ‘Asim said to ‘Uwaymir, ‘You have brought me nothing good. The Messenger of Allah disliked the question I asked him.’ ‘Uwaymir said, ‘By Allah, I will not stop until I ask him about it.’ He came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, among the people and said, ‘Messenger of Allah, what do you think if a man finds another man with his wife? Should he kill him, in which case you would kill him, or what should he do?’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘It has been revealed concerning you and your wife. Go and bring her here.’ Sahl said: They invoked curses upon one another while I was present with the people. When they had finished, ‘Uwaymir said, ‘Messenger of Allah, I would be lying about her if I kept her.’ He divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah ordered him to do so. After they had finished invoking curses, he separated from her before the Messenger of Allah, who said, ‘That is the separation between every two spouses who invoke curses upon one another.’ Ibn Jurayj said: Ibn Shihab said: The practice after them was to separate spouses who invoke curses upon one another. She was pregnant, and her son was attributed to his mother. The practice concerning inheritance was that she inherited from him and he inherited from her whatever Allah had prescribed for him. Ibn Jurayj said, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi, concerning this report, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘If she gives birth to a red, short child like a small lizard, I think she has spoken the truth and he has lied about her. If she gives birth to a black-eyed, dark-skinned child with large buttocks, I think he has spoken the truth about her.’ She gave birth to the kind he disliked.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5309, book 68, باب التَّلاَعُنِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الْمُلاَعَنَةِ، وَعَنِ السُّنَّةِ، فِيهَا عَنْ حَدِيثِ، سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ أَخِي بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلاً وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، أَيَقْتُلُهُ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِي شَأْنِهِ مَا ذَكَرَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ قَضَى اللَّهُ فِيكَ وَفِي امْرَأَتِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلاَعَنَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَأَنَا شَاهِدٌ، فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا قَالَ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا‏.‏ فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ فَرَغَا مِنَ التَّلاَعُنِ، فَفَارَقَهَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ تَفْرِيقٌ بَيْنَ كُلِّ مُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَكَانَتِ السُّنَّةُ بَعْدَهُمَا أَنْ يُفَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ، وَكَانَتْ حَامِلاً، وَكَانَ ابْنُهَا يُدْعَى لأُمِّهِ، قَالَ ثُمَّ جَرَتِ السُّنَّةُ فِي مِيرَاثِهَا أَنَّهَا تَرِثُهُ وَيَرِثُ مِنْهَا مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَحْمَرَ قَصِيرًا كَأَنَّهُ وَحَرَةٌ، فَلاَ أُرَاهَا إِلاَّ قَدْ صَدَقَتْ وَكَذَبَ عَلَيْهَا، وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أَسْوَدَ أَعْيَنَ ذَا أَلْيَتَيْنِ، فَلاَ أُرَاهُ إِلاَّ قَدْ صَدَقَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ عَلَى الْمَكْرُوهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya narrated to us: ‘Abd al-Razzaq informed us: Ibn Jurayj informed us, saying: Ibn Shihab informed me about the spouses who invoke curses and the practice concerning them, in the report of Sahl ibn Sa‘d, the brother of Banu Sa‘idah: An Ansari man came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and said, ‘Messenger of Allah, what do you think if a man finds another man with his wife? Should he kill him, or what should he do?’ Allah revealed concerning his case what He mentioned in the Quran about spouses who invoke curses. The Prophet said, ‘Allah has decided concerning you and your wife.’ They invoked curses against one another in the mosque while I witnessed it. When they finished, he said, ‘Messenger of Allah, I would be lying about her if I kept her,’ and he divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah ordered him to do so. When they had finished invoking curses, he separated from her in the presence of the Prophet, who said, ‘That is the separation between every two spouses who invoke curses upon one another.’ Ibn Jurayj said: Ibn Shihab said: The practice afterward was to separate spouses who invoke curses upon one another. She was pregnant, and the child was attributed to his mother. The practice concerning inheritance was that she inherited from him and he inherited from her according to what Allah prescribed for him. Ibn Jurayj said, from Ibn Shihab, from Sahl ibn Sa‘d al-Sa‘idi, concerning this hadith: The Prophet said, ‘If she gives birth to a red, short child like a small lizard, I think she has spoken the truth and he has lied about her. If she gives birth to a black-eyed, dark-skinned child with large buttocks, I think he has spoken the truth about her.’ She gave birth to the kind he disliked.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5310, book 68, باب قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ كُنْتُ رَاجِمًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ ‏"‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَ التَّلاَعُنُ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ قَوْلاً، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَشْكُو إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ مَا ابْتُلِيتُ بِهَذَا إِلاَّ لِقَوْلِي، فَذَهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتَهُ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ مُصْفَرًّا قَلِيلَ اللَّحْمِ سَبْطَ الشَّعَرِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي ادَّعَى عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ خَدْلاً آدَمَ كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ شَبِيهًا بِالرَّجُلِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ زَوْجُهَا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ، فَلاَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَجَمْتُ أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ رَجَمْتُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَتْ تُظْهِرُ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ السُّوءَ قَالَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ خَدِلاً‏.‏
en_text: Sa‘id ibn ‘Ufayr narrated to us, saying: Al-Layth narrated to me, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ibn ‘Abbas, who said: Mutual imprecation was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. ‘Asim ibn ‘Adi made a comment about it and then left. A man from his people came to him complaining that he had found another man with his wife. ‘Asim said, ‘I have only been tested with this because of what I said.’ He took him to the Prophet and told him what he had found his wife doing. The man was yellow-complexioned, lean, and straight-haired, while the man he alleged he had found with his wife was dark-skinned, broad-bodied, and heavyset. The Prophet said, ‘O Allah, make it clear.’ The woman gave birth resembling the man her husband said he had found with her, so the Prophet had them invoke curses upon one another. A man in the gathering said to Ibn ‘Abbas, ‘Is she the woman about whom the Prophet said, “If I were to stone anyone without proof, I would stone her”?’ He replied, ‘No. That was a woman who openly displayed wrongdoing in Islam.’ Abu Salih and ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf said: ‘Khadhil’ means broad-bodied.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5311, book 68, باب صَدَاقِ الْمُلاَعَنَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ فَرَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَىْ بَنِي الْعَجْلاَنِ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏ فَأَبَيَا فَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَقَالَ لِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ إِنَّ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَيْئًا لاَ أَرَاكَ تُحَدِّثُهُ قَالَ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ مَالِي قَالَ قِيلَ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا فَقَدْ دَخَلْتَ بِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَهْوَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْكَ‏.‏
en_text: ‘Amr ibn Zurarah narrated to me: Isma‘il informed us, from Ayyub, from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr, who said: I asked Ibn ‘Umar about a man who accused his wife. He said, ‘The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, separated the two brothers of Banu al-‘Ajlan and said, “Allah knows that one of you is lying. Will either of you repent?” They both refused. He said it again, and they both refused. He said it a third time, and they refused, so he separated them.’ Ayyub said: ‘Amr ibn Dinar told me that there is something in the hadith that I do not see you narrating.’ He said: The man asked, ‘What about my property?’ He was told, ‘You have no property. If you have spoken truthfully, you had intercourse with her; if you have lied, it is even farther from you.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5312, book 68, باب قَوْلِ الإِمَامِ لِلْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ،، فَقَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ ‏"‏ حِسَابُكُمَا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَحَدُكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، لاَ سَبِيلَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَدَقْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَهْوَ بِمَا اسْتَحْلَلْتَ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَذَبْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَذَاكَ أَبْعَدُ لَكَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَيُّوبُ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ لاَعَنَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ ـ وَفَرَّقَ سُفْيَانُ بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى ـ فَرَّقَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَىْ بَنِي الْعَجْلاَنِ، وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ حَفِظْتُهُ مِنْ عَمْرٍو وَأَيُّوبَ كَمَا أَخْبَرْتُكَ‏.‏
en_text: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, saying: ‘Amr said: I heard Sa‘id ibn Jubayr say: I asked Ibn ‘Umar about spouses who invoke curses. He said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said to them, ‘Your reckoning is with Allah. One of you is lying, and you have no claim against her.’ The man said, ‘What about my property?’ He said, ‘You have no property. If you have spoken truthfully about her, that was in return for the intimacy you had with her; if you have lied about her, it is even farther from you.’ Sufyan said: I memorized this from ‘Amr. Ayyub said: I heard Sa‘id ibn Jubayr say: I asked Ibn ‘Umar about a man who invoked curses against his wife. He gestured with two fingers—and Sufyan separated his index and middle fingers—and said, ‘The Prophet separated the two brothers of Banu al-‘Ajlan and said, “Allah knows that one of you is lying. Will either of you repent?”’ He said this three times. Sufyan said: I memorized it from ‘Amr and Ayyub as I have told you.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5313, book 68, باب التَّفْرِيقِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَذَفَهَا، وَأَحْلَفَهُمَا‏.‏
en_text: Ibrahim ibn al-Mundhir narrated to me: Anas ibn ‘Iyad narrated to us, from ‘Ubayd Allah, from Nafi‘, that Ibn ‘Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, informed him that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, separated a man from his wife after he accused her, and made them both swear oaths.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5314, book 68, باب التَّفْرِيقِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لاَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، وَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Yahya narrated to us, from ‘Ubayd Allah, who said: Nafi‘ informed me, from Ibn ‘Umar, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, had a man and a woman from the Ansar invoke curses upon one another, and he separated them.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5315, book 68, باب يَلْحَقُ الْوَلَدُ بِالْمُلاَعِنَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَعَنَ بَيْنَ رَجُلٍ وَامْرَأَتِهِ، فَانْتَفَى مِنْ وَلَدِهَا فَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَأَلْحَقَ الْوَلَدَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, saying: Nafi‘ narrated to me, from Ibn ‘Umar, that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, had a man and his wife invoke curses upon one another. The man disavowed the child, so the Prophet separated them and attributed the child to the woman.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5316, book 68, باب قَوْلِ الإِمَامِ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذُكِرَ الْمُتَلاَعِنَانِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ قَوْلاً، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ، فَذَكَرَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلاً، فَقَالَ عَاصِمٌ مَا ابْتُلِيتُ بِهَذَا الأَمْرِ إِلاَّ لِقَوْلِي‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتَهُ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ مُصْفَرًّا قَلِيلَ اللَّحْمِ سَبْطَ الشَّعَرِ، وَكَانَ الَّذِي وَجَدَ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهِ آدَمَ خَدْلاً كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ جَعْدًا قَطَطًا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَيِّنْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَوَضَعَتْ شَبِيهًا بِالرَّجُلِ الَّذِي ذَكَرَ زَوْجُهَا أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا، فَلاَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَهُمَا، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ هِيَ الَّتِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ رَجَمْتُ أَحَدًا بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ لَرَجَمْتُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لاَ تِلْكَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَتْ تُظْهِرُ السُّوءَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ‏.‏
en_text: Isma‘il narrated to us, saying: Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to me, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id, who said: ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim informed me, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ibn ‘Abbas, who said: The two spouses who invoke curses were mentioned in the presence of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. ‘Asim ibn ‘Adi made a comment about it and then left. A man from his people came to him and told him that he had found another man with his wife. ‘Asim said, ‘I have only been tested with this matter because of what I said.’ He took him to the Messenger of Allah and told him what he had found his wife doing. The man was yellow-complexioned, lean, and straight-haired, while the man he said he had found with his wife was dark-skinned, broad-bodied, heavyset, and tightly curled-haired. The Messenger of Allah said, ‘O Allah, make it clear.’ The woman gave birth resembling the man her husband said he had found with her, so the Messenger of Allah had them invoke curses upon one another. A man in the gathering said to Ibn ‘Abbas, ‘Is she the woman about whom the Messenger of Allah said, “If I were to stone anyone without proof, I would stone her”?’ Ibn ‘Abbas said, ‘No. That was a woman who openly displayed wrongdoing in Islam.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5317, book 68, باب إِذَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَتْ بَعْدَ الْعِدَّةِ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ فَلَمْ يَمَسَّهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ، الْقُرَظِيَّ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً، ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا فَتَزَوَّجَتْ آخَرَ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِيهَا، وَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ هُدْبَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَتَّى تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ، وَيَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: ‘Amr ibn ‘Ali narrated to us: Yahya narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from ‘A’ishah, from the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. ‘Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: ‘Abdah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, that Rifa‘ah al-Qurazi married a woman and then divorced her. She married another man and came to the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. She told him that the man did not come to her and had only something like a fringe. He said, ‘No, not until you have tasted his sweetness and he has tasted yours.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5318, book 68, بَابُ: {وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ أُمِّهَا أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يُقَالُ لَهَا سُبَيْعَةُ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ زَوْجِهَا، تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا وَهْىَ حُبْلَى، فَخَطَبَهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ بْنُ بَعْكَكٍ، فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَنْكِحَهُ، فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَصْلُحُ أَنْ تَنْكِحِيهِ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِّي آخِرَ الأَجَلَيْنِ‏.‏ فَمَكُثَتْ قَرِيبًا مِنْ عَشْرِ لَيَالٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْكِحِي ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: Al-Layth narrated to us, from Ja‘far ibn Rabi‘ah, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Hurmuz al-A‘raj, who said: Abu Salamah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman informed me that Zaynab bint Abi Salamah told him, from her mother, Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, that a woman from Aslam called Subay‘ah was married to a man who died while she was pregnant. Abu al-Sanabil ibn Ba‘kak proposed to her, but she refused to marry him. He said, ‘By Allah, it is not lawful for you to marry until you have completed the longer of the two waiting periods.’ She remained for nearly ten nights, then came to the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, who said, ‘Marry.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5319, book 68, بَابُ: {وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ كَتَبَ إِلَى ابْنِ الأَرْقَمِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ، سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةَ كَيْفَ أَفْتَاهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ أَفْتَانِي إِذَا وَضَعْتُ أَنْ أَنْكِحَ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us, from al-Layth, from Yazid, that Ibn Shihab wrote to him that ‘Ubayd Allah ibn ‘Abd Allah informed him, from his father, who wrote to Ibn al-Arqam asking him to ask Subay‘ah al-Aslamiyyah what ruling the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, had given her. She said, ‘He ruled that when I gave birth, I could marry.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5320, book 68, بَابُ: {وَأُولاَتُ الأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ الأَسْلَمِيَّةَ، نُفِسَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا، بِلَيَالٍ فَجَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْهُ أَنْ تَنْكِحَ، فَأَذِنَ لَهَا، فَنَكَحَتْ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Qaza‘ah narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, from Hisham ibn ‘Urwah, from his father, from al-Miswar ibn Makhramah, that Subay‘ah al-Aslamiyyah gave birth a few nights after her husband died. She came to the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and asked his permission to marry, and he gave her permission. So she married.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5321, 5322, book 68, باب قِصَّةِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَذْكُرُ، أَنَّ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، طَلَّقَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، فَانْتَقَلَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، فَأَرْسَلَتْ عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِلَى مَرْوَانَ وَهْوَ أَمِيرُ الْمَدِينَةِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَارْدُدْهَا إِلَى بَيْتِهَا‏.‏ قَالَ مَرْوَانُ فِي حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ إِنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ غَلَبَنِي‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَوَمَا بَلَغَكِ شَأْنُ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ قَالَتْ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لاَ تَذْكُرَ حَدِيثَ فَاطِمَةَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَرْوَانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ إِنْ كَانَ بِكِ شَرٌّ فَحَسْبُكِ مَا بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ مِنَ الشَّرِّ‏.‏
en_text: Isma‘il narrated to us: Malik narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Sa‘id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, who heard him mention that Yahya ibn Sa‘id ibn al-‘As divorced the daughter of ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hakam, and ‘Abd al-Rahman moved her out of her home. ‘A’ishah, Mother of the Believers, sent word to Marwan, who was governor of Madinah, saying, ‘Fear Allah and return her to her home.’ In Sulayman’s report Marwan said, ‘‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hakam overpowered me.’ Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad said, ‘Has the case of Fatimah bint Qays not reached you?’ She said, ‘It will not harm you not to mention Fatimah’s report.’ Marwan ibn al-Hakam said, ‘If there is evil in you, the evil between these two is enough for you.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5323, 5324, book 68, باب قِصَّةِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ مَا لِفَاطِمَةَ أَلاَ تَتَّقِي اللَّهَ، يَعْنِي فِي قَوْلِهَا لاَ سُكْنَى وَلاَ نَفَقَةَ
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Ghundar narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, who said: ‘What is the matter with Fatimah? Should she not fear Allah?’—meaning concerning her statement that there is no housing and no maintenance.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5325, 5326, book 68, باب قِصَّةِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ لِعَائِشَةَ أَلَمْ تَرَيْنَ إِلَى فُلاَنَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَكَمِ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا الْبَتَّةَ فَخَرَجَتْ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعَتْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعِي فِي قَوْلِ فَاطِمَةَ قَالَتْ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهَا خَيْرٌ فِي ذِكْرِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَابَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَشَدَّ الْعَيْبِ وَقَالَتْ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ كَانَتْ فِي مَكَانٍ وَحِشٍ فَخِيفَ عَلَى نَاحِيَتِهَا، فَلِذَلِكَ أَرْخَصَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: ‘Amr ibn ‘Abbas narrated to us: Ibn Mahdi narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, who said: ‘Urwah ibn al-Zubayr said to ‘A’ishah, ‘Have you seen so-and-so, the daughter of al-Hakam? Her husband divorced her conclusively, and she left.’ She said, ‘How badly she acted.’ He said, ‘Have you not heard what Fatimah said?’ She said, ‘She has no good in mentioning that report.’ Ibn Abi al-Zinad added, from Hisham, from his father: ‘A’ishah strongly criticized her and said, “Fatimah was in a lonely place, and her safety was feared. For that reason the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, granted her that allowance.”’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5327, 5328, book 68, باب الْمُطَلَّقَةِ إِذَا خُشِيَ عَلَيْهَا فِي مَسْكَنِ زَوْجِهَا أَنْ يُقْتَحَمَ عَلَيْهَا، أَوْ تَبْذُوَ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا بِفَاحِشَةٍ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حِبَّانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، أَنْكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ‏.‏
en_text: Hibban narrated to me: ‘Abd Allah informed us: Ibn Jurayj informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from ‘Urwah, that ‘A’ishah rejected that view of Fatimah.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5329, book 68, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ أَنْ يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي أَرْحَامِهِنَّ} مِنَ الْحَيْضِ وَالْحَبَلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ لَمَّا أَرَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَنْفِرَ إِذَا صَفِيَّةُ عَلَى باب خِبَائِهَا كَئِيبَةً، فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ عَقْرَى ـ أَوْ حَلْقَى ـ إِنَّكِ لَحَابِسَتُنَا أَكُنْتِ أَفَضْتِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَانْفِرِي إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Sulayman ibn Harb narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us, from al-Hakam, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from ‘A’ishah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said: When the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, wanted to depart, he found Safiyyah standing by the entrance of her tent, looking sad. He said to her, ‘May you be bereaved—or may your head be shaven!—you are holding us back. Did you perform the circumambulation of departure on the Day of Sacrifice?’ She said, ‘Yes.’ He said, ‘Then set out.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5330, book 68, بَابُ: {وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ زَوَّجَ مَعْقِلٌ أُخْتَهُ فَطَلَّقَهَا تَطْلِيقَةً‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad narrated to me: ‘Abd al-Wahhab informed us: Yunus narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said: Ma‘qil married off his sister, and her husband divorced her once.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5331, book 68, بَابُ: {وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ}
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، أَنَّ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، كَانَتْ أُخْتُهُ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ فَطَلَّقَهَا، ثُمَّ خَلَّى عَنْهَا حَتَّى انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا، ثُمَّ خَطَبَهَا فَحَمِيَ مَعْقِلٌ مِنَ ذَلِكَ أَنَفًا فَقَالَ خَلَّى عَنْهَا وَهْوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ يَخْطُبُهَا فَحَالَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="232" aya_end="232"]{‏وَإِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَبَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَلاَ تَعْضُلُوهُنَّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ، فَدَعَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ، فَتَرَكَ الْحَمِيَّةَ وَاسْتَقَادَ لأَمْرِ اللَّهِ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me: ‘Abd al-A‘la narrated to us: Sa‘id narrated to us, from Qatadah: Al-Hasan narrated to us that Ma‘qil ibn Yasar’s sister was married to a man who divorced her and left her until her waiting period ended. Then he proposed to her again. Ma‘qil’s pride was stirred by this, and he said, ‘He left her while he had the right to her, then he proposes to her again?’ So he prevented them from marrying. Then Allah revealed, ‘When you divorce women and they reach the end of their waiting period, do not prevent them…’ (2:232), through the end of the verse. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, called Ma‘qil and recited it to him. Ma‘qil gave up his pride and submitted to Allah’s command.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5332, book 68, بَابُ: {وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ أَحَقُّ بِرَدِّهِنَّ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَةً لَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ تَطْلِيقَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، ثُمَّ يُمْسِكَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ، ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ عِنْدَهُ حَيْضَةً أُخْرَى، ثُمَّ يُمْهِلَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا، فَإِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَهَا فَلْيُطَلِّقْهَا حِينَ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا، فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُطَلَّقَ لَهَا النِّسَاءُ‏.‏ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ لأَحَدِهِمْ إِنْ كُنْتَ طَلَّقْتَهَا ثَلاَثًا فَقَدْ حَرُمَتْ عَلَيْكَ، حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِيهِ غَيْرُهُ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَوْ طَلَّقْتَ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ، فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَنِي بِهَذَا‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah narrated to us: Al-Layth narrated to us, from Nafi‘, that ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with them both, divorced one of his wives once while she was menstruating. The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, ordered him to take her back and keep her until she became pure, then menstruated again while with him, then wait until she became pure from that menstruation. If he then wanted to divorce her, he should do so when she was pure and before he had intercourse with her. That is the waiting period during which Allah commanded women to be divorced. When ‘Abd Allah was asked about this, he would tell a man, ‘If you have divorced her three times, she is forbidden to you until she marries another husband.’ Another narrator added from al-Layth: Nafi‘ said that Ibn ‘Umar would say, ‘If you had divorced her once or twice, the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, instructed me about what to do.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5333, book 68, باب مُرَاجَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ، سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ طَلَّقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهْىَ حَائِضٌ، فَسَأَلَ عُمَرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقَ مِنْ قُبُلِ عِدَّتِهَا، قُلْتُ فَتَعْتَدُّ بِتِلْكَ التَّطْلِيقَةِ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَجَزَ وَاسْتَحْمَقَ‏.‏
en_text: Hajjaj narrated to us: Yazid ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Sirin narrated to us: Yunus ibn Jubayr narrated to me, saying: I asked Ibn ‘Umar. He said, ‘Ibn ‘Umar divorced his wife while she was menstruating. ‘Umar asked the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and he ordered him to take her back, then divorce her before her waiting period began.’ I asked, ‘Does he count that divorce as part of her waiting period?’ He said, ‘What do you think? If he were incapable and foolish?’
